items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: when I was writing that book, and give it to Louis Lomax, I expected him to take the names out like I hired him to do.

ctx.x: Well, see, when I was writing that book, and give it to Louis Lomax, I expected him to take the names out like I hired him to do. And all the people would have laughed at themselves, that I wrote about.
